name: atlas-path-meta-ads-2026-motion
description: Motion graphics promocional de 40 s — Curso Meta Ads 2026 · Atlas Path

scripts.render: remotion render MetaAds2026 out/render_raw.mp4 && npm run finalize
scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -i out/render_raw.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -profile:v high -level 4.2 -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -color_range tv -c:a copy -movflags +faststart out/AtlasPath_MetaAds2026_40s.mp4
